content.description: Visual funnel showing booking lifecycle stages with counts at each stage. Stages based on actual cspPortalBookings.status values: Draft → Confirmed → In Progress → Completed. Cancelled shown separately as a note. Each stage is a horizontal bar with count, colored by stage. Clickable stages link to filtered booking list at /customer-portal/bookings?status=X. Shows conversion rate between adjacent stages. Rendered as a Server Component section on the dashboard page below the KPI cards.
acceptance_criteria: Dashboard shows a 'Booking Pipeline' section below the KPI cards grid
Funnel displays 4 stages: Draft → Confirmed → In Progress → Completed with counts from cspPortalBookings grouped by status
Each stage is a horizontal bar whose width is proportional to the count (widest = max count, narrowest = min count)
Each stage shows: stage label, count, and conversion rate from previous stage (e.g., '75% from Draft')
Cancelled bookings shown as a separate small note below the funnel (not part of the main flow)
Query includes tenantId filter and deletedAt IS NULL
Empty state: if zero bookings, show 'No bookings yet' with link to create one
Dark mode support on all elements
edge_cases: All bookings in one stage (e.g., all draft) — that stage bar is full width, others show '0'
Zero bookings — show empty state message
Very large counts — use compact number format
Conversion rate from 0 to N — show 'New' instead of infinity%
error_handling: Query failure — show 'Unable to load pipeline data' message in the section
Auth failure — handled by parent page redirect
security_considerations: tenantId filter mandatory on all queries
content.implementation_notes: Add a new section to src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx between the KPI cards and the activity feed grid. Use a single GROUP BY query on cspPortalBookings.status to get all counts in one query. Create a BookingPipelineFunnel client component at src/components/dashboard/booking-pipeline.tsx for the visual funnel. The funnel is purely visual — horizontal bars with Tailwind, no chart library needed.
affected_files: src/app/(dashboard)/page.tsx — add pipeline query and render BookingPipelineFunnel
testing_requirements: Funnel renders with correct counts per stage
Click navigation works to filtered booking list
Empty state renders when no bookings exist
